title: 建築環境設計Ⅱ
subtitle: Environmental Design for Architecture II
keywords: Energy conservation building 2.Air conditioning system 3.Building eqipments 4.Primary energy consumption
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn about energy conservation buildings. (2) learn about zero energy buildings. (3) learn how to realize net-Zero Energy Building
advice: In this course, students learn about actual conditions of energy conservation buildings and zero energy buildings. Students will also come to understand the features of the thermal performance of exterior wall and the new building equipments. 1. Features of energy conservation buildings located throught Japan 2. Features of energy conservation buildings located in Hokuriku region 3. Environmetal design for architecture using subterranien heat
requiredKnowledge: Students should have taken Environmental Design for Architecture I.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain the envelope thermal performance of energy conservation buildings.
Students can explain the equipment system of energy conservation buildings.
Students can give an overview of primary energy consumption of architecture.
Students can explain how to realize the zero energy buildings
